## Texts and drawings (2)

- **E0917** (text, sure): 内务府 repair list 乾隆四十三年 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆四十三年 1778 · S220 section 三; archive not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 明善堂后碧涛书屋、双寿寺、眺吟楼、浩然亭、松风萝月等处捞堆坍塌山石泊岸、码头，勾抿油灰
  Earliest dated mention of these places. Settles the plan readings of QC53 松风萝月 and QC54 眺吟楼, both partly unread on S01.
- **E2397** (description, sure, search index only): 圆明三园中的船坞. not seen · mhymy xsjl/6203 · S42. https://www.mhymy.com/xsjl/6203.html
  Nine docks across the three gardens, two in Qichun. 松风萝月 dock on the north of the back lake, facing east, boats 般若观 and 浮汉槎. 喜雨山房 dock on the west of the back lake, on a north-south line, joining the long river to the south. Z-QN01, Z-QN02 fit by position only; which is which is ours.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 松风?月 (? marks an unread character), 3x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
